decisions.reason: Changing the 5V_EN control pin does not alter the LED board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the confirmed 5V LED supply or level-shifter requirement.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that changes boost_enable_gpio from GPIO3 to GPIO5; no correction or additional removal is required.
The source changes MCU pin assignments but does not alter the sensor modules, their connector role, or their 3.3V supply.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording 5V_EN as GPIO5, SCL0 as GPIO38, SPI_MOSI as GPIO26, and the unexposed GPIO list.
The 5V_EN and bus-pin reassignments do not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or 3.3V power-path requirements.
The GPIO changes do not affect the standalone ME6211A 3.3V supply, its activation condition, or source-selection behavior.
The source decision concerns MCU signal assignments and does not affect battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or clearance.
Reassigning GPIO signals does not change the component sourceability or connector-selection policy.
The interboard connector continues to carry the named 5V_EN and SCL0 signals; changing their MCU GPIO mappings does not alter the connector types, pin count, or recorded signal pinout.
The source changes electrical GPIO assignments and has no effect on board dimensions, mounting, connector position, or enclosure fit.
The GPIO reassignment does not resolve or alter the battery connector's series, mounting type, or electrical pinout.
